Form 1 — Scio Network Member – ALL

We are reconnecting with network members and refreshing how Scio Network works. This short check-in lets you confirm whether you would like to remain affiliated and update the information we use to stay in touch and understand your profile.

Being a Network Member creates no obligation to participate or accept consulting work. Joining our Consultant Roster is a separate, optional step.

What’s your name?

Select your country code, then enter the rest of your number.

Third person, max 300 words. Focus on what you do and for whom.

0 / 300 words

Used only for proposals and the website if you’ve given the relevant consent below.

JPG / PNG

In which country are you currently based?
Which areas are closest to your work?

Tick all that apply.

Which countries do you know well and/or have substantial professional experience in?
Which companies and organisations have you worked with in a meaningful professional capacity? Please list the most relevant ones.
Would you like to join Scio’s Consultant Roster and be considered for paid assignments through Scio Network?

This is an optional, non-exclusive status for members who are professionally able and interested in undertaking consulting work. It takes about five more minutes to set up.

By joining the Scio Network, you consent to Scio Network GmbH & Co. KG storing and processing the personal information you provide as part of your network profile. We use this information to administer the Scio Network, maintain and update your profile, communicate with you, and connect you with relevant people, activities and opportunities within the network.

We process your Network profile based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. Your profile will be retained for as long as you remain part of the Scio Network, unless you withdraw your consent or request deletion earlier.

Scio may use AI-supported tools to help organise network information and identify potentially relevant people or opportunities. Scio remains responsible for how your data is handled, does not use your personal data to train external AI models, and maintains human involvement in decisions that may affect you.

Public visibility of your Network profile

Scio is a professional network and may present its members and their expertise publicly as part of operating and promoting the Scio Network. Subject to confirmation of the applicable legal basis, Scio intends to process this information on the basis of its legitimate interests in maintaining a visible professional network, communicating the expertise available within the Network and presenting the Network to clients, partners and other stakeholders.

The following settings are enabled by default. You may change them now or at any time later.

You may opt out of these uses, withdraw your consent, or exercise your rights to access, correct or delete your personal data at any time by contacting admin@scio.net. Where processing is based on Scio’s legitimate interests, you also have the right to object under Art. 21 GDPR.

For further information about how we process your personal data, the legal bases we rely on and your rights under the GDPR, please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.scio.net/privacy
